### Lunch in Egypt
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lunch-egypt
Passage: Genesis 43:16-34
Points:
- Joseph's fearful brothers are received with unexpected hospitality and comforted by the steward's testimony of God's providence.
- Joseph tests his brothers to see if they still harbor the same bitter jealousy that led them to sell him.
- Benjamin receives five times more food than the others, giving the brothers an opportunity to resent him.
- The brothers celebrate freely without envy, demonstrating their spiritual growth and transformation over the years.
- Believers are challenged to practice genuine gratitude for what God provides rather than begrudging blessings given to others.

### Strength to Weep - Today's Insight - September 29, 2023
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-29-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 43:29-30
Points:
- Encountering his brother Benjamin caused Joseph's composure to collapse under a flood of deep emotion.
- Even powerful leaders experience moments when grief, loneliness, and long-delayed sorrow overwhelm them.
- Joseph stepped away to a private room to weep rather than suppress his genuine human feelings.
- Faithfulness does not require maintaining a stoic facade of invulnerability.
- Stepping into honest vulnerability and allowing ourselves to weep is a mark of true strength.
